episodes.title: That Wonhan Bastard
episodes.summary: While facing some internal anger for his harsh corporate changes, So Baek-ho clashes with the fierce Kim Mi-kyung when he visits her potato research lab.

episodes.title: The Hot Director
episodes.summary: After Baek-ho unwittingly moves into Mi-kyung's guest house and sets up an office at her lab, she turns the village against him — resulting in a fiasco.

episodes.title: The Price of a Kiss
episodes.summary: After Mi-kyung panics to avoid running into Baek-ho, he comes to her aid during a potato cooking competition. She later runs into a figure from her past.

episodes.title: This message has been deleted
episodes.summary: Baek-ho deals devastating news to Mi-kyung, forcing her to figure out her next steps. But later, an emergency forces the two to work together.

episodes.title: Person of Interest
episodes.summary: Baek-ho and Mi-kyung see new sides of each other, and feelings begin to blossom. A new arrival at the guesthouse stirs jealousy in Mi-kyung.

episodes.title: False Goat's Beard
episodes.summary: After a shakeup at the potato lab, Baek-ho and Mi-kyung take a business trip together. But soon after, Baek-ho starts avoiding her, leaving her confused.

episodes.title: Softie Sweetie
episodes.summary: With their feelings made clear, Mi-kyung and Baek-ho head out on their first date. But shortly after, they realize that rumors spread quickly at work.

episodes.title: Lethal
episodes.summary: The sudden appearance of an unwelcome visitor wreaks havoc at the guesthouse. Mi-kyung later panics out after discovering a secret relationship.

episodes.title: I Regret It
episodes.summary: While Mi-kyung struggles with past wounds, Baek-ho worries about her well-being. Later, they share a tender and intimate moment in a potato flower field.

episodes.title: Yes
episodes.summary: After witnessing a surprising moment between Park Ki-se and Mi-kyung, Baek-ho learns the truth about her past — leading him to confess everything.

episodes.title: Disaster
episodes.summary: Feeling betrayed by Baek-ho, Mi-kyung shuts him out. But as the tension between the two escalates, their colleagues scheme to reconcile them.

episodes.title: MK107
episodes.summary: Mi-kyung's lab days dwindle, leaving her future with Baek-ho uncertain. What will their next chapter hold?
